name: ForkLift
tagline: Manage your local files and remote transfers side by side in a dual-pane workspace.
description:
ForkLift is a dual-pane file manager and transfer client for macOS. It combines local file operations with remote connections, making it useful for people who regularly move material among disks, servers, and cloud storage without wanting separate tools for each destination.

## Features

- Browse two locations side by side and copy or move files between them.
- Connect through SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Google Drive, Dropbox, and other supported services.
- Synchronize folders, compare locations, rename batches, and queue transfers.
- Preview files, edit remote files with a chosen editor, and save changes back to the server.
- Mount remote connections for access from Finder and other applications.
- Use tabs, favorites, workspaces, keyboard shortcuts, and configurable tools for recurring jobs.

## Where it fits

ForkLift is for developers, site operators, photographers, and anyone who wants a more capable Finder alternative with remote transfer support. It is broader than a simple drag-and-drop shelf and more visual than command-line transfer tools.

## Privacy and requirements

ForkLift requires macOS 14.6 or later. Remote credentials and transferred data are necessarily shared with the services you configure; use trusted hosts and appropriate account security. The application is distributed directly by BinaryNights.

## Pricing

A single-user lifetime license costs $19.95 with one year of updates or $34.95 with two years. The covered version continues working after the update period.
